# Health Products Compliance Guidance
## Substantiation
Health-related claims must be supported by competent and reliable scientific evidence. Such claims generally must be substantiated with high-quality randomized controlled clinical trials.

## Establishment claims
Claims that say a product has a specific level of support, such as clinically proven or doctor recommended, are establishment claims, and the advertiser must have at least the level of evidence the claim conveys.

## Consumer testimonials
Testimonials that do not reflect typical results are likely misleading unless the advertiser clearly discloses the generally expected results. Material connections, such as payment, must be clearly disclosed.
